LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 3.1.1 PRONUNCIATION AND VOCABULARY

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.1: Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary, part of Strand 3 in Grade 5 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: Why should you use polite expressions when talking to others?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen to correct pronunciation of sounds, phrases, and expressions from the teacher, audio-visual recordings among others,

2. practise saying the sound /ɔɪ/ in words.

3. practise using polite words 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to correct pronunciation of sounds, phrases, and expressions from the teacher, audio-visual recordings among others,
2. practise saying the sound /ɔɪ/ in words.
3. practise using polite words 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Pronunciation and Vocabulary together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self-Efficacy is nurtured as the learner engages in role play using polite words, phrases and expressions.

• Digital Literacy is achieved as the learner uses digital devices to listen to the pronunciation of target sounds, words

and phrases.

Values:
Love is inculcated as the learner puts the interests of others first through role play as well as listening/reciting poems

related to the theme.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Life Skills Education: effective communication is enhanced through the proper articulation of sounds and use of polite

expressions.

Link to other Learning Areas:

This learner is able to relate the concept on etiquette and table manners to the learning of similar concepts in
